verdict.rationale: Community evidence references Vite as an official-style tooling improvement for Vue 3 setup (vue-comm-6) and multiple users describe getting started in minutes/hours (vue-comm-12, vue-comm-13), and the docs site's Getting Started section is confirmed via probe (vue-probe-1), but the pack never explicitly cites the official CLI/scaffold command (e.g., create-vue) or a dedicated starter template walkthrough. missing for 10: explicit documentation or independent confirmation of the create-vue/Vue CLI scaffolding command and its step-by-step quick-start experience.
